assessment.closest_mechanisms: Established CEGAR/lazy abstraction, bounded may-reachability, ordinary whole-input memoization and conservative finite constraint pruning. The selected literature review supports this narrower lineage and is not exhaustive.
assessment.independence_boundary: Checker logic is separate from candidate caches/search, but shared preserved language/validation operators and same research workflow do not constitute independent human review or mechanized source-to-model proof.
assessment.measurement_boundary: Shared explicitly charges canonical key/payload/history nodes while direct language._key and _assignments do not meter comparable serialization/domain-key construction. Equal numerical allowances compare declared method-specific accounting policies, not equal computation or hardware budgets. End-to-end checker costs and equivalent-resource measurements remain necessary for practical speed claims.
assessment.supported_contribution: Executable task-relative finite admission semantics, separate certificate checking, source-bound benchmark/measurement artifacts and reproducible adverse cache/search/proof-representation observations.

remaining_work: For algorithmic distinctness: specify a concrete operation/proof representation that closest known methods cannot already reproduce, and justify it against those exact mechanisms. Prefix and relation memoization alone do not satisfy this.

For practical performance: prospectively compare the resulting candidate with goal-pruned cached direct and constraint-pruned direct using comparable end-to-end resource budgets, repeated/randomized execution order, checking costs and all unknown/failure denominators.

For application validity: complete actual native confirmation/approval/replay/cross-session obligations and missing workflow harnesses; original ADK AP2 prefixes currently stop before OTP/purchase. Resolve failures only in successors with fresh captures.

For generalization: obtain separately authored human-reviewed task/gold obligations and untouched held-out cases, then evaluate real provider/model behavior and continuous source-to-profile/dispatch/task-effect correspondence.

For paper readiness: retain negative findings and semantic claim limits, secure human scientific contribution judgment and assess venue fit without treating code/audit completion as novelty or publication approval.
review_type: Static source and existing literature/manuscript assessment; no solver/App/model/provider calls, no Git calls, no human scientific approval.

shared_implemented_properties.property: Exact path-prefix summaries retain full correlated frontiers, uncertainty, contract-known flag and current history; invocation-local keys do not cross calls.
Relation summary keyed by edge plus whole frame publishes only after complete expansion; an early witness or exception leaves a miss unpublished.
History reconstruction attaches reused local steps to the current prefix, preserving witness continuity rather than reusing a stale path history.
Original abstract goal-path enumeration, exact infeasible-prefix trie refinement and path-list negative proof remain; reuse does not compress the refutation representation.

properties.property: Goal-relevant bounded state/depth/correlated-whole-frame product; expansion skipped before legal tuple enumeration if target cannot reach a safe possible goal in remaining horizon.
Existing call-local relation cache keyed by edge and canonical whole binding frame; complete tuple sequence reused and first feasible goal returns early.
Independent negative cut reconstructs exact goal-relevant product closure without candidate relation cache/history; shared preserved recipe-language operators are disclosed.
Guard supplement prunes only closed definitely false guards and uses the original complete tuple interpreter; no arc-consistency fixpoint or AC-3.
